Market today:
Sentiment is mixed, but a key driver for your book, chip stocks, are showing signs of life after a tough period. This could offer some relief or opportunities for managing your concentrated tech/chip positions.

Your holdings:
SMCI is a major concern, trading well below its stop at -25.47%. Your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, SPAL) are also flagged SELL with significant losses (-54.74%, -29.12%, -34.27% respectively), amplified by margin and decay. CRWD is a strong winner at +30.75% but also flagged SELL.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on how chip stocks perform today to see if the reported rebound holds. Also, monitor overall market sentiment, especially for tech, given the global debt concerns.

Bottom line:
Focus on aggressive risk management and protecting capital, especially with your leveraged and deeply negative positions.
plays: SMCI is trading below its stop of 37.3; consider exiting to prevent further losses on this -25.47% position.
Review leveraged ETFs SOXL (-54.74%), MUU (-29.12%), and SPAL (-34.27%) flagged SELL; their decay and deep losses on margin demand attention.
CRWD is up 30.75% but flagged SELL; consider taking some profits or tightening its stop to protect gains.
